title: M3-PG projects accordion
description: Selected work as a hairline-boxed accordion. On desktop a short intro and an 'all projects' link hold the first column, and the box fills the other three: one open panel (wide photo, title, text, link, a big grey index number) beside narrow closed columns, each a grey plus, a title running up the column and its number; hovering a column inks it dark, clicking it widens it open (flex and background, 0.25s). On phones it becomes a vertical list of numbered rows with plus signs. The photo zooms to 1.1 on hover.
notes: five or six projects suit the desktop row; closed columns are 66px wide each
sits on its own background above a sticky band before it (relative z-10)
